main.description: G5 INVARIANT — a civil/corp record produced by civil-registry or corp-registry (birth/death/marriage/residency/incorporation). immutable is const true: a record is APPENDED to the kotoba Datom log, never overwritten (非終末論, UN CRVS append-only). A correction is itself an appended record; there is no delete/overwrite. For an incorporation, lei carries an ISO 17442 / MOD 97-10 valid identifier.

immutable.description: G5 INVARIANT — always true. Append-only; never overwritten (ADR-2605312345 + 非終末論).

lei.description: ISO 17442 LEI (incorporation only); ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 valid
